name: Jitsi Meet
author: Jitsi
description: Jitsi Meet is a fully encrypted, 100% open source video conferencing solution. No account needed — just share a link and start a meeting.

form_fields.label: Public URL
form_fields.hint: Full URL where Jitsi will be accessed — must match what users type in their browser.

form_fields.label: Jicofo Auth Password
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated internal password for Jicofo authentication.

form_fields.label: JVB Auth Password
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated internal password for the video bridge.

form_fields.label: JVB Advertise IP
form_fields.hint: Public IP of this server. Required if running behind NAT for media to work.
